title: Ewoks
description: EWOKS look like little furballs, but these simple, primitive beings are strong-willed, fiercel loyal, and attuned to their environment on Endor. At first encounter, it looks like they will make a stew of the Rebels they capture, but after explanations are made they become staunch allies against the Imperial invaders. Here, Joe Johnston, art director-visual effects, shows the Ewoks setting a trap for the seemingly invincible AT-ST walkers (front), then springing it (back).
